steps.name: Setup — Create Pipeline 1 and Pipeline 2 via API
Step 1 — In Tab A, open Pipeline 1 and verify the tab title
Step 2 — Open a second, brand-new browser tab and navigate it to the dashboard; verify Tab A is unaffected and both tabs coexist
Step 3 — In Tab B, open Pipeline 2 and verify its title
Step 4 — Verify both tabs coexist with their own correct, independent titles

Step 5 — Switch back to Tab A and verify it switches back to Pipeline 1 (title AND the detail page's own Name field, not just the title — catches a tab that kept its old title but silently navigated/reset its content)
Step 6 — Close Tab B and verify Tab A remains open and fully functional
Step 7 — Side-channel check — zero console errors across the whole multi-tab flow
